preview_vs_production_mode.client_app_preview_routes: /app/preview/* render CLIENT_APP_FIXTURES manifests and PREVIEW_REVIEW_OBJECTS entirely client-side; gated by isSite00ClientAppPreviewFeatureActive (DEV or VITE_SITE00_CLIENT_APP_PREVIEW=1 on cloud preview/tunnel host). No API calls for reviews; preview review actions POST to /api/site00/client-reviews with projectSlug 'preview-client-room' which requires SITE00_CLIENT_REVIEW_PREVIEW_MODE=1 server-side.
preview_vs_production_mode.previewReviewMemoryStore: Only active when VITEST==='true' AND preview bypass env set AND not SITE00_CLIENT_REVIEW_SUPABASE_INTEGRATION (previewReviewMemoryStore.ts:61-64). Not used in production.
preview_vs_production_mode.review_persistence_in_production: Supabase tables site00_client_review_* via service-role client. Real backend exists.
preview_vs_production_mode.preview_bypass_safety: Fail-closed: disabled when VERCEL_ENV=production / SITE00_PRODUCTION=1 / NODE_ENV=production (non-preview); module throws if bypass env set in production (previewGuard.ts:12-41).
fixtures_leaking_into_production: getClientAppManifestPayload returns CLIENT_APP_FIXTURES for any slug starting 'fixture-app-' to any authenticated user (appService.ts:29-44)
projects?fixtureMode=multi returns fixture list to any authenticated user (appService.ts:72-78)
empty project list injects fixture NDXBOOK card (AppProjectSelectPage.tsx:17-32)
inbox threads & library files are fixtures for every real project (appContent.ts)
Home copy/activity/decisions are template fixtures for real projects (manifestTemplates.ts, manifestBuilder.ts)
preview_vs_production_mode.verdict: Production mode is backed by Supabase for project identity, ownership and review persistence; everything else displayed in production is template/fixture content.

security_findings.finding: Client-controlled role: POST body.role and GET roleOverride are passed into reviewService and used instead of the server-resolved role
security_findings.impact: A CLIENT_VIEWER/COLLABORATOR can approve by sending role:'CLIENT_OWNER'

security_findings.finding: Review mutations do not verify versionId belongs to reviewId; comment/annotation accept arbitrary versionId
Approval does not require review.approvalAllowed/status check server-side (only capability), so approving a REVISION_IN_PROGRESS or SUPERSEDED review is possible if currentVersionId matches
security_findings.evidence: reviewService.ts:345-358 (no review.approvalAllowed check; decline does check perms at 497-498)

security_findings.finding: RLS is service_role-only on review tables; no per-client policies; enforcement is API-only

Admin feedback endpoint gates on isAdminEmail but assertReviewProjectAccess also requires owner match, so admins not owning the project get FORBIDDEN — the founder cannot actually read client feedback

test_coverage_note: Tests exercise preview-client-room fixtures (memory store under Vitest) and pure shared builders.
